title: Photos, videos, files and stickers in a chat
summary: Timeline rows for image, video, file and sticker messages: a thumbnail or file card that downloads and decrypts on the device, a caption, and a tap that opens the media viewer or the file.

kind.description: From MessageType Image, Video and File, and the sticker content. Audio and voice are message-voice.

caption.description: The caption (body when it differs from the file name). Plain text.

fileName.description: file: the name shown on the card.

sizeText.description: The size formatted by the system (1,2 MB).

durationText.description: video: the length formatted by the system.

aspectRatio.description: width:height from ImageInfo or VideoInfo, so the row has its size before the thumbnail loads.

blurhash.description: ImageInfo or VideoInfo blurhash, shown while the thumbnail loads.

loadState.description: hidden: the show media setting says to wait for a tap. failed: download or decryption failed.

showMedia.description: The chats setting bipe_chats_show_media (registries/settings.json chats.showMedia). privateChats: load in DMs and closed groups only.

loadThumbnail.effect: When the row comes on screen and showMedia allows it: Client.getMediaThumbnail at the row size (sticker and small images: Client.getMediaContent). The SDK decrypts encrypted media and caches it.

open.effect: image and video: opens media-viewer at this item. file: Client.getMediaFile to a temporary file, then the system open or share sheet. sticker: opens the sticker sheet (save, see the pack).

saveSticker.effect: sticker of another person: adds it to My stickers (the personal MSC2545 pack) and shows bipe_sticker_saved or bipe_sticker_save_failed.

notes: bipe_app_media_file_label is the accessibility label of a file card: %1$s the file name, %2$s the size. bipe_app_notification_image and bipe_app_notification_video are the labels of a photo or video without a caption.

Animated stickers (GIF, WebP, APNG) play in the row. Bipe logic: BipeAnimatedImage.frameCount and BipeAnimatedImage (iOS); sticker content: Sticker and StickerPack (iOS StickerPacks.swift, Android stickers/StickerPacks.kt).
A caption runs through the scam check like a text message (message-scam-warning).

Images that look like a payment receipt get bipe_warning_receipt_image at the bottom edge (trust-ui.md). No shared detector exists yet in bipe-shared, BipeKit or libraries/bipe; the label waits for one (open point).
Galleries (MessageType Gallery) show as separate images in phase 1. Location and polls are other specs.
Never upload or log media outside the SDK. The media cache lives in the SDK store on the device.
